description:
Objective: the API must handle boundary and invalid input without server-side failures.

  NOTE: JSONPlaceholder is a mock API that accepts almost any body. Scenarios in the default run
  therefore assert what matters for robustness (no 5xx, fast response, valid JSON) and record
  the actual status. Scenarios tagged @known-issue assert the stricter expectation from the brief
  (4xx for invalid data) and are expected to fail against this service. Run them with
  `npm run test:known-issues`. See README "API test findings".

elements.name: Baseline - a valid post is created

steps.name: I send a POST to "/posts" with the "valid" payload
the response status is 201
the response is JSON containing an id
the response time is within the limit

description:
Charts are canvas elements, so the app exposes the plotted values on the canvas
  (data-values) and the tests check them for validity.

elements.name: Dashboard bar chart is visible with valid non-zero data

steps.name: I open the application
the dashboard bar chart is visible
the bar chart has 3 bars, all with values greater than zero

elements.name: Pie chart shows principal and interest for a calculated loan

steps.name: I open the application
I open the "EMI Report" view
I calculate a loan of 2500000 at 10 percent for 10 years
the pie chart is visible
both pie chart sections have values greater than zero
the pie chart sections equal the independently calculated principal and interest for 2500000, 10 and 10

elements.name: Pie chart shows principal and interest for a calculated loan

steps.name: I open the application
I open the "EMI Report" view
I calculate a loan of 5000000 at 7.5 percent for 15 years
the pie chart is visible
both pie chart sections have values greater than zero
the pie chart sections equal the independently calculated principal and interest for 5000000, 7.5 and 15

name: Charts render valid data

description:
As a loan analyst I want a summary of my loan portfolio
  so that I can see total exposure at a glance.

elements.name: Dashboard loads with the portfolio summary

steps.name: I open the application
the page title "Loan EMI Dashboard" is visible
the dashboard shows 3 loans in the portfolio table
the portfolio summary cards are populated
there are no console errors

elements.name: Dashboard totals match independently calculated values

steps.name: I open the application
the dashboard totals match the independently calculated values for the sample loans

elements.name: User navigates to the EMI report view

steps.name: I open the application
I open the "EMI Report" view
the EMI form is displayed with its three inputs
the "Dashboard" content is hidden

name: Dashboard

description:
The report view calculates EMI from the user's input. Expected values are calculated
  independently in test code, not copied from the page.

elements.name: Submitted input produces the independently calculated output

steps.name: I open the application
I open the "EMI Report" view
I calculate a loan of 2500000 at 10 percent for 10 years
the displayed EMI matches the independently calculated EMI for 2500000, 10 and 10
the displayed total interest and total payment match for 2500000, 10 and 10
the yearly schedule has 10 rows
